decisions.decision: 429 deferral only for GET requests, writes keep fail-fast
decisions.rationale: Stale play/pause/seek firing seconds late would mutate playback state unexpectedly (Fable 5 M-01)
Probes have their own deferral mechanism, mixing would stall probe chain (Fable 5 L-01)
Prevents thundering herd when multiple deferred requests fire at window close (Fable 5 L-02)
